cases.about: Please send information about her life, dreams or interests to shecounted@gmail.com
cases.narrative:
She died on 4/7/2026.

Authorities said she had pulled into Annie's Family Kitchen restaurant's parking lot on Cleveland Avenue when she honked her horn. Bond then allegedly crossed the street and approached Woodcock's vehicle before firing shots at her.
